sourceFile: 37. BRS-161016 Report test material from New supplier Zhongke  11.5.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparison evidence but changed-factor and outcome grouping need correction before final use.
issues: Changed factor is too broad and mixes supplier, test labels, and MG types.
Baotou/normal supplier should be baseline context, not a separate primary factor.
Gauss outcome omits Yoke rows and misses NG conclusions for SMG long/short.
Function result is overstated as improved; source says comparable to normal and usable for MG-C.
Some cited rows are not shown in context, limiting verification of extracted metrics.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as Zhongke new supplier material versus normal/Baotou baseline.
Use MG-S-A, MG-S-B, MG-C, SMG long/short, CMG/CPT, and Yoke as subgroup keys.
Add gauss judgments reflecting SMG-S-A/S-B not usable, MG-S-C OK, and include Yoke rows.
Revise function judgment to no meaningful change/equivalent with usable MG-C conclusion.
Ensure all cited metric rows are available and row citations cover headers, paired data, and decisions.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are mostly sufficient for existence but not sufficient for final evidence until missing context and grouping citations are fixed.
